Name: Planet Crashmania 9,000,000
Overview:
The goal of Planet Crashmania 9,000,000 is to get all of a planet's inhabitants to other planets before the planet's orbit is decayed (i.e. before the time limit runs out). Both the other planets and the player avatar automatically rotate around the decaying planet. In order to bring the people to safety, the player needs to build a rocket with a single button press, aim it with the analogue stick and shoot it towards another planet. If the rocket hits, everyone on the rocket lives - but if it misses or hits the home planet, they die. To beat the level, a certain amount of people have to be saved.

Unfortunately they are also obstacles to deal with: asteroids which block the path and aliens which try to destroy the planets. Both of the obstacles can be cleared by hitting them with a nuke. Hitting power-ups with nukes reward benefits. Nukes are used identically to rockets.
